newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - September 26.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - September 26.

text.p: The Federal Reserve had no large one-day net miss in its reserve projections, a Fed spokesman said.

As for the pattern of borrowing, about 60 percent of the adjustment borrowing for the week was done by the small banks, while about 40 percent was done by the large regionals. No borrowing was done by the money center banks.
As for the pattern of borrowing on Wednesday, eight percent of the borrowing was done by the small banks, while 92 percent was done by the large regionals. No borrowing was done by the money centers.
The high in natural float was about $900 million on Tuesday, while the low was about $250 million on Thursday.

Transportation float averaged a bit under $50 million per day with the high on Tuesday at about $150 million, primarily due to weather-related delays in the St. Louis area and air mechanical delays in other locations.
